description: 50% of invoiced customers must be FULLY PLANNED in Granular Insights by the deadline. Partial or draft plans do not count.

description: Hold at least one set-up customer meeting between 1/1 and 3/31/2027. Size doesn't matter, but it must be a PLANNED meeting -- impromptu conversations don't count.
